cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Opening Order
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for starting a tiny moon muffin market story with one clear opening event: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, pull out three blank desk-drawer slips, and name the first market sound together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Fill the slips in order so the moon muffin stall opens before anything else happens: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the moon muffin bell rings when ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the silver tray rolls toward ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the first paper wrapper closes around ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Add one order word before the second event: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Point to the event that must happen first and explain why: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three slips silently before writing one market word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell the market opening with three new pretend drawer slips: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Parcel Path
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for moving one pretend puddle parcel through first, next, then, and finally: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw four small puddle boxes, and choose one made-up parcel job: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the parcel trip step by step so each puddle box has one event: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the puddle parcel slides onto ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the splash sorter sends it toward ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the stamp puddle changes because ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the parcel reaches the desk drawer marked ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Choose one time word that helps the parcel move: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Make sure the final stop could not happen before ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Tap the four puddle boxes in order before filling one blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try the parcel path again with a different pretend stamp: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Ticket Row
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for placing library train events in an order a reader can follow: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, cut four paper ticket shapes, and choose the train's first shelf stop: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Line up the tickets from first stop to last stop before writing the train scene: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the Buttonwood Library Train arrives beside ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the shelf car opens and reveals ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the train rolls the book cart to ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Add a train-moving phrase between two tickets: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Move any ticket that belongs earlier and name the clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the tickets with tiny dots before reading one sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Rebuild the library train row with four new paper tickets: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Fix
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for turning a bakery map mix-up into problem, attempt, and fix: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold a scrap map into the desk drawer, and mark one wrong crumb path: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Show how the map mix-up starts, grows clearer, and gets fixed in order: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the button bakery map points to ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the tray carrier follows the crumbs and finds ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the baker spots the wrong label because ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the map is fixed when ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Add a bridge from problem to solution: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Underline the step that actually solves the mix-up: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Trace the wrong crumb path with one finger before writing: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Make a new folded bakery map with one different fix: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Weather Change
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for showing how a tiny teacup setting changes one weather step at a time: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw four little window panes, and choose the first pretend weather clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Move through the panes in order so Teacup Town changes gently from start to finish: ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the cup-handle bridge begins to ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the tiny town square changes when ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Add a phrase that shows the weather changed: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Circle the setting detail that changes after the first pane: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch one weather mark in each pane before writing: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell the weather-window sequence with four new pane clues: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice Chain
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for building a pocket park notice into a clear cause-and-effect chain: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw one small notice board, and invent a harmless paper notice together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write what the notice says, what it causes, and how the park changes afterward: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the Pocket Park notice board announces ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, one bench-side helper reacts by ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the pocket park feels different because ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Transition prompt: Add one cause-and-effect phrase before the third step: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Draw an arrow from the notice to the effect it caused: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to each arrow in order before filling one blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Make another pretend park notice and follow its effect chain: ____________________.
